title: [Testing] Zero unit tests across the entire monorepo - no test runner configured
label: bug
body:
There are no test files, no jest/vitest config, and no test script in any package.json. The codebase has zero automated test coverage.

**Fix:** Configure Vitest for the frontend and Jest/Supertest for the API server. Add a test script to the root package.json.

title: [Testing] No integration tests for any API endpoint
label: bug
body:
No endpoint has an automated test. Core flows like POST /api/analyses, the Paystack webhook, and auth sync are completely untested.

**Fix:** Add Supertest-based integration tests for all critical routes.

title: [Testing] No E2E tests for the core analysis workflow
label: enhancement
body:
The full user journey (signup -> upload resume -> analyze -> view results -> download PDF) has no automated E2E coverage.

**Fix:** Add Playwright or Cypress E2E tests covering the critical analysis user flow.

title: [Testing] No test for free plan enforcement - limit can be silently broken by code changes
label: critical
body:
The 3-analysis free limit logic has no test. Any refactor could disable it without detection, causing revenue loss.

**Fix:** Add a test that verifies the 4th analysis attempt returns HTTP 403 for free plan users.

title: [Testing] No test for Paystack webhook signature validation
label: critical
body:
The validateWebhookSignature() function is never tested. A bug could allow unsigned webhooks to upgrade arbitrary users to Pro.

**Fix:** Add unit tests for valid and invalid webhook signatures.

title: [Testing] No test for the AI response JSON parser in ai.ts
label: critical
body:
The JSON.parse(content) in analyzeResume() has no test. Truncated OpenAI responses (at max_tokens limit) produce invalid JSON that crashes the server.

**Fix:** Add unit tests for the parser with mocked responses including truncated and malformed JSON cases.

title: [Testing] No test for PDF/DOCX/image text extraction pipeline
label: enhancement
body:
The resumes/extract endpoint handles PDF, DOCX, and OCR image paths. None of these code paths are tested.

**Fix:** Add integration tests using fixture files for each supported format (PDF, DOCX, PNG).

title: [Testing] No snapshot tests for any UI components
label: enhancement
body:
No component has a snapshot or visual regression test. UI regressions in key components go completely undetected.

**Fix:** Add Vitest + Testing Library snapshot tests for key components like ScoreMeter, CopyButton, and DiffView.

title: [Testing] No test for the LCS diff algorithm in analysis-detail.tsx
label: enhancement
body:
The computeDiff() function is a custom O(m*n) LCS implementation with no unit tests. Edge cases (empty strings, identical content, very long lines) are untested.

**Fix:** Extract computeDiff to a utility module and add comprehensive unit tests.

title: [Testing] No test for the job scraper Cheerio selector logic
label: enhancement
body:
The scrape-job endpoint tries multiple CSS selectors to find job description text with complex fallback logic. None of it is tested.

**Fix:** Add unit tests mocking axios and testing each selector priority and the fallback to body text.

title: [DevOps] No .env.example file - contributors cannot know which environment variables are required
label: critical
body:
There is no .env.example in the repository. Contributors must read through the entire source code to discover all required env vars (DATABASE_URL, SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET, PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY, PAYSTACK_PLAN_CODE, etc.).

**Fix:** Create a comprehensive .env.example listing all required and optional variables with descriptions and example values.

title: [DevOps] No GitHub Actions CI pipeline - PRs are merged with no automated checks
label: critical
body:
There is no .github/workflows/ directory. No CI runs on pull requests, meaning broken code can be merged without detection.

**Fix:** Add a CI workflow that runs pnpm install, type-check (tsc --noEmit), lint, and tests on every PR.

title: [DevOps] No GitHub Actions CD pipeline - deployments are entirely manual
label: enhancement
body:
Deployments are done manually via Replit. There is no automated deploy on merge to main, leading to inconsistent deployment practices.

**Fix:** Add a CD workflow that triggers deployment on push to main branch.

title: [DevOps] drizzle-kit push used in production - schema changes cannot be rolled back
label: critical
body:
The DB setup uses drizzle-kit push which applies schema changes directly with no migration files. If a bad schema change is pushed to production, there is no rollback path.

**Fix:** Switch to drizzle-kit generate + migrate workflow and commit all migration files to the repository.

title: [DevOps] /api/healthz returns ok without checking DB connectivity
label: enhancement
body:
The health check endpoint returns { status: 'ok' } unconditionally. If the database is down or unreachable, the health check still passes, misleading load balancers and monitoring tools.

**Fix:** Execute a SELECT 1 query in the health check and return HTTP 503 if it fails.

title: [DevOps] No graceful shutdown handler - in-flight requests are killed on SIGTERM
label: enhancement
body:
The server has no process.on('SIGTERM') or process.on('SIGINT') handler. Running requests are abruptly terminated during deployment restarts.

**Fix:** Add graceful shutdown that stops accepting new connections, waits for active requests to complete (with a timeout), then exits.

title: [DevOps] No startup validation of required env vars - missing DATABASE_URL causes cryptic runtime crash
label: enhancement
body:
If DATABASE_URL is missing, the app starts successfully but crashes with an obscure pg connection error at the first DB call, not at startup.

**Fix:** Add a startup validator using zod or a custom check that lists all missing required env vars and exits with a clear error message.

title: [DevOps] package-lock.json present in repo root alongside pnpm-lock.yaml - dual package manager conflict
label: bug
body:
Having both package-lock.json (npm) and pnpm-lock.yaml (pnpm) in the same repo confuses contributors and CI tools about which package manager to use.

**Fix:** Delete package-lock.json, add it to .gitignore, and enforce pnpm via the engines field in package.json.

title: [DevOps] No Renovate or Dependabot configured - security patches for dependencies are not automated
label: enhancement
body:
No automated dependency update bot is configured. Security vulnerabilities in npm dependencies will go unpatched until manually noticed by a contributor.

**Fix:** Add a Renovate config or Dependabot .github/dependabot.yml to automate dependency updates.

title: [DevOps] No pino-pretty in development - JSON logs are unreadable in terminal
label: enhancement
body:
Pino outputs structured JSON log lines in development mode, which are difficult to read in a terminal without external tooling.

**Fix:** Add pino-pretty as a dev dependency and configure the logger to use pretty-printing when NODE_ENV=development.

title: [Accessibility] Animated blobs on login/signup have no prefers-reduced-motion check
label: enhancement
body:
The Framer Motion infinite animations on login/signup pages play regardless of the user's prefers-reduced-motion OS setting, causing issues for users with vestibular disorders or motion sensitivity.

**Fix:** Use Framer Motion's useReducedMotion() hook and disable animations when it returns true.

title: [Accessibility] Delete button on analysis-detail is icon-only with no aria-label
label: critical
body:
The Trash2 icon delete button in analysis-detail.tsx has no aria-label or title attribute. Screen readers announce it as an unlabeled button.

**Fix:** Add aria-label='Delete analysis' to the delete button element.

title: [Accessibility] Score Meter SVG has no accessible text - screen readers cannot read the score
label: critical
body:
The circular SVG progress meter in analysis-detail.tsx has no role='img', aria-label, or <title> element. Screen readers cannot convey the match score to visually impaired users.

**Fix:** Add role='img' and aria-label={'Match score: ' + score + ' out of 100'} to the SVG element.

title: [Accessibility] Login/signup inputs missing autocomplete attributes - password managers cannot autofill
label: enhancement
body:
The email and password inputs do not have autocomplete='email', autocomplete='current-password', or autocomplete='new-password' attributes. Password manager and browser autofill are impaired.

**Fix:** Add appropriate autocomplete attributes to all auth form inputs.

title: [Accessibility] Matched vs missing keywords distinguished by color only - fails WCAG 1.4.1
label: critical
body:
Keywords are shown as green (matched) or red (missing) chips. Users with red/green color blindness (affects ~8% of males) cannot distinguish them without color.

**Fix:** Add an icon (CheckCircle for matched, XCircle for missing) to each keyword chip alongside the color coding.

title: [Docs] CONTRIBUTING.md has no local dev setup instructions - new contributors are blocked
label: critical
body:
CONTRIBUTING.md links to GitHub Issues for tasks but does not explain how to run the project locally (PostgreSQL setup, Supabase credentials, Paystack test keys, pnpm commands, port configuration).

**Fix:** Add a detailed 'Local Development' section to CONTRIBUTING.md.

title: [Docs] No Swagger/ReDoc UI served from the API - OpenAPI spec not accessible to developers
label: enhancement
body:
The openapi.yaml file exists but is not served as an interactive documentation UI. Developers must read raw YAML to understand the API.

**Fix:** Serve swagger-ui-express or @scalar/express-api-reference at /api/docs.

title: [Docs] mockup-sandbox package has no README - its purpose is undocumented
label: enhancement
body:
The artifacts/mockup-sandbox directory exists with no README.md explaining what it is for, how to run it, or how it relates to the rest of the project.

**Fix:** Add a README.md to artifacts/mockup-sandbox explaining its purpose.

title: [Docs] replit.md is Replit-specific only - no instructions for self-hosted or local deployment
label: enhancement
body:
replit.md explains how to run on Replit but there are no instructions for developers who want to run the project locally or deploy to their own server.

**Fix:** Add a 'Self-Hosting' section to the main README with local PostgreSQL, Supabase local, and Paystack test setup instructions.

title: [Docs] No CHANGELOG.md - users and contributors cannot track changes between releases
label: enhancement
body:
There is no changelog file. Contributors cannot see what was changed recently, and users have no release history to reference.

**Fix:** Add a CHANGELOG.md following the Keep a Changelog format and update it with each meaningful change.

title: [Bug] POST /api/analyses response includes raw interviewQuestions JSON string instead of parsed array
label: bug
body:
In POST /api/analyses, the response spreads finalAnalysis (which has interviewQuestions as a JSON string) without parsing it. Clients receive a string instead of an array.

**Fix:** Parse interviewQuestions in the response the same way keywordsMatched and keywordsMissing are parsed.

title: [Bug] GET /api/analyses response does not parse interviewQuestions - returns raw JSON string in list
label: bug
body:
In the GET /api/analyses list handler, keywordsMatched and keywordsMissing are parsed but interviewQuestions is not. The client receives a raw JSON string for this field.

**Fix:** Add JSON.parse for interviewQuestions in the map() transformation function.

title: [Bug] GET /api/analyses/:id also returns interviewQuestions as raw JSON string
label: bug
body:
The single-analysis GET endpoint has the same interviewQuestions parsing omission as the list endpoint. The field is sent as a raw JSON string to clients.

**Fix:** Parse interviewQuestions before sending in the single-analysis response, consistent with keyword fields.

title: [Bug] Dashboard average score calculation includes analyzing records with matchScore=0 - skews stats
label: bug
body:
GET /dashboard/stats uses avg(matchScore) which includes 'analyzing' status records with matchScore=0, incorrectly skewing the average score downward.

**Fix:** Add WHERE status='completed' filter to the average score calculation query.

title: [Security] No per-user file extraction rate limit - CPU exhaustion via repeated Tesseract OCR requests
label: critical
body:
The aiRateLimiter is the only protection on /resumes/extract. A user can repeatedly upload image files triggering Tesseract OCR, which is CPU-intensive and can saturate the server.

**Fix:** Add a strict per-user rate limit (e.g. 10 extractions per hour) specifically for the extraction endpoint.

title: [Security] Paystack webhook returns 200 on DB errors - plan upgrades silently lost, Paystack won't retry
label: critical
body:
The webhook handler catches DB errors and still returns res.sendStatus(200). Paystack considers the event delivered and won't retry. Users who pay may not get their Pro plan activated.

**Fix:** Return HTTP 500 on DB errors so Paystack retries the webhook delivery.

title: [Bug] Settings page has no Change Password functionality for email/password users
label: bug
body:
Users who signed up with email/password have no way to change their password from within the app settings.

**Fix:** Add a Change Password form in Settings using supabase.auth.updateUser({ password: newPassword }).

title: [Bug] Profile image URL not updated when Google OAuth user changes their avatar
label: bug
body:
The authMiddleware and auth/user endpoint upsert profileImageUrl from JWT claims, but if a user changes their Google avatar, the update only propagates after a full logout and re-login.

**Fix:** Ensure every authenticated request updates profileImageUrl from the current JWT claims, not just on initial sync.

title: [Performance] Landing page reviews query has no staleTime - refetches on every page mount
label: enhancement
body:
useListReviews on the landing page has no staleTime configured in TanStack Query. Reviews are refetched on every single landing page visit even though they rarely change.

**Fix:** Set staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000 (5 minutes) on the reviews query to reduce unnecessary network requests.

title: [Performance] No virtual scrolling on History page - all analysis cards rendered in DOM simultaneously
label: enhancement
body:
The history page renders every analysis card in the DOM simultaneously. With hundreds of analyses, this causes significant layout thrashing and slow initial render.

**Fix:** Implement pagination (preferred) or use @tanstack/react-virtual for virtualized rendering.

title: [Bug] PDF export via pdfkit uses Helvetica font - non-Latin characters render as blank boxes
label: bug
body:
The server-side PDF export in analyses.ts uses PDFDocument with the default Helvetica font, which does not include non-Latin glyphs. Resumes with CJK, Arabic, or Cyrillic text will have missing characters.

**Fix:** Embed a Unicode-supporting font (e.g. Noto Sans) in the PDF generation code.

title: [Bug] PDF export endpoint does not set Content-Length - download progress bar never shows
label: enhancement
body:
The streaming PDF response from GET /analyses/:id/export has no Content-Length header, so the browser cannot show a download progress indicator.

**Fix:** Generate the PDF to a buffer first, then set the Content-Length header before streaming the response.

title: [Bug] analyzeResume has no request timeout - hung OpenAI connection blocks handler indefinitely
label: critical
body:
If OpenAI's API hangs (no response), the POST /api/analyses handler waits forever, holding the server connection open until the client times out.

**Fix:** Add a timeout using AbortSignal.timeout(60000) or Promise.race with a 60-second deadline to the OpenAI API call.

title: [Bug] Stuck analyzing status records never cleaned up if server crashes mid-analysis
label: bug
body:
If the server crashes after inserting the 'analyzing' record but before the AI responds, the record stays in 'analyzing' state permanently, showing as stuck in the user's history.

**Fix:** Add a startup job that resets any analyses stuck in 'analyzing' for more than 5 minutes to a 'failed' status.

title: [Bug] No React Error Boundary in analysis-detail.tsx - any render error shows a blank white page
label: bug
body:
If the analysis-detail page throws a runtime error during render (e.g. malformed data from the API), the entire page goes blank with no error message or navigation options.

**Fix:** Wrap the page in a React Error Boundary component that shows a meaningful error state with a back button.

title: [UX] No avatar upload in Settings - users cannot personalize their profile picture
label: enhancement
body:
The Settings page allows editing first/last name but has no avatar upload functionality. Supabase Storage supports file uploads.

**Fix:** Add an avatar upload input in Settings that uploads to Supabase Storage and updates the profileImageUrl via PATCH /api/user/settings.

title: [UX] No inline field validation messaging on Analyze page - submit button disabled with no explanation
label: enhancement
body:
The submit button is disabled until all 3 required fields are filled, but there is no per-field validation feedback explaining which specific field is missing.

**Fix:** Add inline validation messages (e.g. 'Job title is required') under each required field when the user blurs without entering content.

title: [UX] No Save to My Resumes action after analysis - tailored resume cannot be saved directly to library
label: enhancement
body:
After viewing a tailored resume in analysis-detail, users have no way to save it to their resume library directly. They must copy-paste it manually.

**Fix:** Add a 'Save as Resume' button that calls POST /api/resumes with the tailored resume content and job title as the resume name.

title: [UX] No email notification when analysis is complete - users must keep the tab open for 30 seconds
label: enhancement
body:
Analysis takes 15-30 seconds. Users who navigate away miss the result. There is no notification mechanism to alert them when the analysis is ready.

**Fix:** Implement an email notification via Supabase or a transactional email service (e.g. Resend) when analysis status changes to 'completed'.

title: [UX] No dark/light mode toggle - dark mode is hardcoded for all users
label: enhancement
body:
The app forces a dark color scheme with no option for users who prefer light mode. There is no theme toggle in settings or the navigation.

**Fix:** Implement a theme toggle using CSS custom properties and persist the user's preference to localStorage.
